text: The air here is alive with curiosity and discovery. The blend of technology and creative curiosity fills me with a quiet anticipation. The minimalist glass boundaries and the brightly-lit, informative displays stir in me a sense of purpose and wonder. Here, thought and possibility intermingle—I feel as if I am on the threshold of innovation, surrounded by artifacts of mind and machine, humbled and hopeful for what may emerge next from this confluence of research and imagination.
